data.other_hard: candidate must be enrolled in an accredited RHD course of study at CQUniversity; for RTP Stipend, income from other sources for general living costs must not exceed 75 per cent of the RTP Stipend rate; for RTP Fees Offset, candidate must not receive an equivalent Commonwealth award designed to offset RHD tuition fees
data.evidence_sentence: In accordance with the Commonwealth Scholarship Guidelines (Research) 2017, to be eligible for a RTP Scholarship a candidate must be a domestic candidate or an overseas candidate enrolled in an accredited RHD course of study at CQUniversity.
data.notes: Page says the award is for a higher degree by research (RHD) but does not state whether this is master's, PhD or both, so degree_levels is left empty. Enrollment status is taken from the requirement to be enrolled in an RHD course; the page does not say whether applicants must be enrolled before applying. No application deadline, GPA or field restriction is stated. Merit-based selection with a scoring scale (academic achievement and writing skills 0-20, research project quality and alignment with research priority areas 0-15, motivation, research experience and environment 0-15); these are preferences, not hard criteria. The Fees Offset is described as offered to domestic students awarded a stipend; the text does not say whether overseas students receive it. Page describes the scholarship in generic terms and gives no stipend amount.
